concept.hr: Poslovi samo jednog DC-a, što pada bez nositelja; prijenos ili preuzimanje
concept.en: The single-master jobs, what breaks without the holder; transfer vs seize

summary.hr: Ugasi nositelje uloga i pokušaj operacije: prijava radi, shema ne, RID-ovi traju dok ima skupa. Prenesi PDC, preuzmi RID i vrati starog nositelja.
summary.en: Turn role holders off and try operations: logons work, the schema does not, RIDs last while the pool does. Transfer the PDC, seize RID, bring the holder back.
